name: Chemical Equations
overview: A chemical equation gives information about the reactants and products through their symbols and formulae. Note: Unbalanced chemical equation containing molecular formulae of the substances is known as skeleton equation. saq.answer: All the chemical equations must be balanced, because atoms are neither created nor destroyed in chemical reactions. A chemical equation in which the number of atoms of different elements on the reactant side (left side) are same as those on product side (right side) is called a balanced reaction.
